_about: Rules for guard.mjs. field = command (Bash / PowerShell) or file_path (Edit / Write). pattern = regex, case-insensitive. unless = optional regex that cancels the block. Copy this file to .claude/guard.rules.json and edit.

rules.message: destructive git command. Ask the human first, or use a normal commit / a new branch.
no --autostash while other agents have uncommitted edits (it can stash their work).
never kill programs by name (it can close the human's own windows). Stop only the PID you started.
recursive delete outside a temp / scratch folder. Delete single files, or ask the human.
never read or print secret files.
vendored / third-party code is never edited here. Work around it in our own code.
never overwrite a shared log with Write (it can erase rows other agents added). Use Edit to append or change one row.
